label: DR-011
note: The review agent permission block correctly omits a write key because opencode PermissionConfig has no write key; write protection is enforced via permission.edit:deny (and permission.bash:deny for command execution), and reviewer must NOT suggest adding permission.write:deny.

known_false_positive.title: Review agent permission block omits the write permission
known_false_positive.why_it_matters: The permission block denies edit and bash but has no "write" key, so file writes fall back to the default and the review agent can modify the repository under review. Add "write": "deny".
